# Model Adaptation: Fine-Tuning, Distillation and Small Models

> Decide when a small model is worth adapting, then tune, distil, evaluate and serve it with numbers you can defend. SDAIA Academy course AE-310, version 2027.1.0, in English.

Each slide is a heading such as "#### [day1#slide-id] Title": cite slides by that id, and each citation is a link (slides/day1.html#slide-id). These files are what a trainee sees: no speaker notes and no answer keys.

## Course

- [Course page](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-310/index.md): overview, outcomes, schedule and labs; the page itself is https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-310/index.html
- [The whole course](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-310/llms-full.txt): every unit, session and slide in one file, about 24,100 tokens
- [Practice questions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-310/practice.html): questions to check yourself, with feedback after each answer

## Slides

- [Day 1: Decide whether to adapt](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-310/slides/day1.md): Sort the failures, freeze the baseline, read the licences and count the cost before any training; sessions: Prompt, retrieve, tune or distil, The baseline tuning must beat, Licences and terms of open-weight models, Cost and placement of the options; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-310/slides/day1.html; about 5,879 tokens
- [Day 2: Data for tuning](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-310/slides/day2.md): Build the tuning set from traces, corrections and a teacher, render it correctly and clean it; sessions: Tuning data from traces and corrections, Teacher generation and verifier filtering, Chat templates and tool-call formats, Deduplication, decontamination and personal data; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-310/slides/day2.html; about 5,949 tokens
- [Day 3: Train adapters and distil](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-310/slides/day3.md): Train low-rank adapters on 16-bit and 4-bit bases, choose settings on validation and distil a behaviour; sessions: Low-rank adapters, Quantised adapters and memory, Settings that matter, Distilling a behaviour; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-310/slides/day3.html; about 5,287 tokens
- [Day 4: Evaluate and serve](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-310/slides/day4.md): Compare with the base and a larger model, look for what got worse, serve under load and write the decision; sessions: Paired evaluation against the base, Regressions and safety after tuning, One base, several adapters, Cards and the decision memo; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-310/slides/day4.html; about 5,434 tokens
- [Capstone: Capstone: an adapted small model and its defence](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-310/slides/capstone.md): Ten minutes each: the decision memo, a live re-run of the paired comparison and one regression explained; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-310/slides/capstone.html; about 1,028 tokens

## Labs

- [Lab 1.1: Sort the failures](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-310/labs/D1_1_failure_sort.ipynb): Day 1, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 1.2: Freeze the baseline](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-310/labs/D1_2_prompt_baseline.ipynb): Day 1, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 1.3: Three licences](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-310/labs/D1_3_licences.ipynb): Day 1, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 1.4: Cost of two options](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-310/labs/D1_4_cost_placement.ipynb): Day 1, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 2.1: Traces to examples](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-310/labs/D2_1_traces_corrections.ipynb): Day 2, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 2.2: Teacher and verifier](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-310/labs/D2_2_teacher_filter.ipynb): Day 2, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 2.3: Three formatting faults](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-310/labs/D2_3_chat_templates.ipynb): Day 2, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 2.4: Clean the set](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-310/labs/D2_4_dedup_pii.ipynb): Day 2, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 3.1: Train an adapter, read the curves](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-310/labs/D3_1_lora_adapter.ipynb): Day 3, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 3.2: The same adapter on a 4-bit base](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-310/labs/D3_2_four_bit.ipynb): Day 3, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 3.3: Read a sweep, add a run](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-310/labs/D3_3_sweep.ipynb): Day 3, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 3.4: Distil a behaviour](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-310/labs/D3_4_distil.ipynb): Day 3, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 4.1: Three systems, two languages](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-310/labs/D4_1_paired_eval.ipynb): Day 4, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 4.2: What got worse](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-310/labs/D4_2_regressions.ipynb): Day 4, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 4.3: Two adapters, one base, under load](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-310/labs/D4_3_serve_adapters.ipynb): Day 4, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 4.4: Cards, memo and capstone task](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-310/labs/D4_4_cards_memo.ipynb): Day 4, Session 4, 25 min
